messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content: 在這兩手牌中，約翰和邁克都拿到了同樣長度的順子同花（Straight Flush），但邁克的順子從 9 開始，而約翰的順子從 8 開始。順子同花的大小比較是先看最高牌，再逐張比較。兩手牌的最高牌都是 K，接下來都是 Q、J、10，最後邁克的 9 高於約翰的 8。因此邁克贏得這局撲克。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K hearts: that's a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠: that's also a straight flush 9-10-J-Q-K. In poker, higher straight flush wins. John's highest card is K hearts, Mike's highest is K spades. But compare the highest card of the straight flush: John's straight flush is 8-10-J-Q-K, Mike's is 9-10-J-Q-K. The higher straight flush is the one with higher top card. Both have K as top card. But the next highest card: John's next is Q, Mike's next is Q. Next J vs J. Next 10 vs 10. Next 8 vs 9. So Mike's 9 is higher than John's 8. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
